description: Liberty Shoes Ltd. manufactures and trades in footwear, accessories, and lifestyle products in India and internationally. The company offers shoes, boots, fashion, slip-ons, ballerinas, slippers, sandals, formal, and casual footwear under the AHA, Coolers, Force 10, Fortune, Gliders, Healers, Leap7X, Prefect, Lucy & Luke, Warrior, Freedom, Liberty Lifestyle, and Senorita brands. The company operates through distributors and exclusive showrooms, as well as sells its products through retail, e-commerce, and wholesale network channels. Liberty Shoes Ltd. was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in Karnal, India.
